latest.title: Operationalizing Your Steering Strategy: From Local Files to Enterprise Governance
latest.description: Steering files are the linchpin of AI-DLC — they turn AI coding agents from fast-but-generic into fast-and-precise. But every enterprise team hits the same next question: how do I scale steering beyond a single developer's laptop? This post covers three operational patterns, from Git-native distribution to centralized MCP-based delivery, plus a reference architecture for serving steering context to every AI session and autonomous agent in your org. Each stage is independently valuable.

latest.title: Networking Patterns for ISVs Distributing AI Agent Tools via Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
latest.description: This post presents two architecture patterns for ISVs that host AI agent tools (MCP servers) and need to securely distribute them to multiple customer tenants across AWS accounts. Pattern A covers an ISV-hosted centralized gateway with Cedar-based per-tenant isolation. Pattern B covers a customer-owned gateway consuming ISV tools cross-account via VPC Lattice and AWS RAM — with no Transit Gateway or VPC peering required.

latest.title: Amazon Cognito Diagnostic and Troubleshooting Toolkit
latest.description: A diagnostic and troubleshooting toolkit for Amazon Cognito that helps engineers identify authentication, MFA, OAuth, federation, token, Lambda trigger, delivery, Identity Pool, domain, WAF, Managed Login, and threat-protection issues. It supports targeted investigations, comprehensive health checks, redacted reports, S3 output, and CI/CD severity-based validation.
